messages:
ria: Hey — quick question: PR #4123 touches `runtime/` and `models/` (small refactor + schema tweak). CODEOWNERS currently points both dirs at `@eng-infra`. Who is allowed to approve this? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4123 :thinking_face:
cheng: Hmm. Historically `runtime/` is eng-runtime and `models/` is eng-ml. If CODEOWNERS says eng-infra we should update it, but that won't help this PR immediately.
dave: Can someone from eng-infra proxy approve while we get owners to update CODEOWNERS? Is this high-risk?
ria: Tests + e2e passed in CI, small schema rename (backwards compatible). Low risk but touches runtime perf codepath.
britt: I'm on call but can glance. If it's small and CI is green I'm okay to proxy approve once eng-runtime or eng-ml ack in thread. Prefer owners sign off though. :+1:
github-bot: CI status: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint). Labeler: `needs-cross-team-approval` added.
cheng: Suggestion: add a short CODEOWNERS patch in this PR to map dirs to the right teams so future PRs route correctly. Example change:
```
# CODEOWNERS
/runtime/ @eng-runtime-leads
/models/  @eng-ml-leads
```
That way approvals go to the right places.
dave: Good call. @sam (eng-ml-lead) can you review the model changes?
sam (eng-ml-lead): I can take a look this afternoon, should be quick. If nothing blocking, we'll approve.
ria: Thanks — I'll add the CODEOWNERS tweak to the PR branch and add `approver: eng-platform-proxy` label so we can move while waiting for sam.
cheng: Also consider adding a brief note in the PR description `owner-override: eng-platform` with a link to the owners update to be reverted in follow-up if needed.
dave: Sounds good. If sam approves by EOD we can merge after final CI. If not, britt can proxy approve now to unstick release. :clock1:
ria: OK — will update the branch and ping once CODEOWNERS change pushed. Cheers.
